summary: The fixed report and hashed native shards are internally consistent, and enabled DOM input/click, immediate focus sampling, complete state/frame comparisons, and retained callback fencing are present. Request amendment: read-only witnesses take a direct Go dispatch path without a physical-value/state observation or native disabled-event suppression check; focusReplacement and transport/effect channels can be absent or identically wrong on both actors without failure; and error text is normalized away despite the exact replay wire. A bounded offline mutation probe reproduced each checker blind spot with zero issues. Default F-RUN was not repeated or claimed.
